args.text: Gesture: Anjali/namaskara-like two-hand mudra with palms facing each other and fingertips meeting at a single apex. Goal: both hands mirror-symmetric, fingertips of index–little on both hands touch corresponding fingertips to form a pointed top; fingers are all moderately flexed (MCP ~40–60°, PIP ~60–80°, DIP ~20–40°) so fingers are curved and tips meet; thumb flexed across toward the index so thumb tips meet near the apex as well (thumb CMC flex ~20–40°, MCP/IP ~20–40°). Finger abductions set near zero so fingers sit together (small values to close gaps). Hands rotated so palms face each other (yaw ~±90° relative to front) and slightly pitched so fingertips point up/together (pitch small positive). I will first read the current joint angles, then progressively set each hand to the above target while checking with front and top camera views and iterating as needed.

I believe the target is a two-hand classical dance hasta where the palms face each other and the wrists are crossed, with index and little fingers extended and splayed, while the middle and ring fingers are strongly flexed so their tips curl inward and meet between the two hands; the thumbs are flexed/opposed across the palm toward the curled fingers (thumb tips near the curled middle/ring fingers). Both hands are mirror images. Specific intended joint targets per hand (mirror-symmetric):
- Index: mcp 0, pip 0, dip 0 (extended, slightly splayed outward) ; index abduction +15° (away from middle)
- Middle: mcp 90°, pip 100°, dip 80° (strongly curled so tip meets center)
- Ring: mcp 90°, pip 100°, dip 80° (strongly curled)
- Little: mcp 0°, pip 0°, dip 0° (extended) ; little abduction -15° (away from ring)
- Thumb: thumb_cmc_flex +30° (across palm), thumb_cmc_abd 0°, thumb_cmc_rot 0°, thumb_mcp 25°, thumb_ip 25° (curled inward toward middle/ring fingers)
- Finger abductions: middle abduction 0, ring abduction 0
Hand orientation: palms angled slightly toward the camera and upward so the extended index and little fingers point roughly upward in the front view; yaw to tilt fingers toward thumb side +10°, pitch slight toward camera +10°. Hands positions: wrists crossed at midline with right hand slightly in front of left; move right hand toward midline +6 cm, left hand toward midline -6 cm, and raise/lower slightly to match crossing.
I will now start adjusting joints to these targets, iterating with looks to refine.
